# Domain Model — transformation / phases

## Machine

```yaml
header:
  Stage: 2 — Domain Model Verification
  CR: new_subdomain
  Status: DRAFT
  Feeds: Stage 3 — Analysis Loop
registers:
  entities:
    columns:
    - Entity
    - Description
    - Store Model
    - Evidence Status
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Entity: Seed
      Description: The business problem statement reorganized into fixed registers.
      Store Model: Held as a document outside the composition; never stored as protocol state.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: S1 business_vocabulary Seed
    - Entity: Rule Set
      Description: The declared conditions deciding whether a document is admissible.
      Store Model: Carried as declared input on the phase workflow, sealed with it.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: S1 business_vocabulary Rule Set
    - Entity: Verdict
      Description: 'The outcome of applying a rule set: admissible or inadmissible.'
      Store Model: Returned by the phase; not persisted.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: S1 business_vocabulary Verdict
    - Entity: Finding
      Description: One recorded failure of one rule.
      Store Model: Returned within the verdict; not persisted.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: S1 business_vocabulary Finding
    - Entity: Author of Record
      Description: The person accountable for a document's content.
      Store Model: An actor identity bound by the phase workflow.
      Evidence Status: VERIFIED
      Source Finding: S1 business_vocabulary Author of Record
  entity_attributes:
    columns:
    - Entity
    - Attribute
    - Meaning
    - Evidence Status
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Entity: Verdict
      Attribute: admissibility
      Meaning: Whether the document may proceed to the next phase.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 business_invariants #1'
    - Entity: Verdict
      Attribute: rules evaluated
      Meaning: How many rules were applied — every rule, always.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 business_invariants #2'
    - Entity: Finding
      Attribute: rule
      Meaning: The rule that produced the finding.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 business_invariants #4'
    - Entity: Rule Set
      Attribute: active version
      Meaning: The declared rules currently deciding admissibility.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: S1 lifecycle_states Rule Set
    - Entity: Rule Set
      Attribute: sealed copy
      Meaning: The rules as carried in the phase's own compiled artifact, generated from the declaration rather than typed.
      Evidence Status: OBSERVED
      Source Finding: 'S1 known_facts #14'
    - Entity: Seed
      Attribute: carried form
      Meaning: The whole document, travelling with the request as text rather than as a location to be read.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 known_facts #16'
    - Entity: Verdict
      Attribute: reproducibility
      Meaning: A verdict is reproducible from what was judged, which is why nothing is read from a location at judging time.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 known_facts #17'
  business_processes:
    columns:
    - Process
    - Initiator
    - Outcome
    - Evidence Status
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Process: Judge a document
      Initiator: The author of record offering it
      Outcome: A verdict, with every failed rule reported, over the document text it was handed
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 requested_outcomes #2'
    - Process: Accept at a gate
      Initiator: The gate reviewer
      Outcome: The document may be consumed by the next phase
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: S1 business_events Seed Accepted
  process_steps:
    columns:
    - Process
    - 'Step #'
    - Action
    - Record Produced
    - Evidence Status
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Process: Judge a document
      'Step #': '1'
      Action: Read the document into its registers
      Record Produced: The registers
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 requested_outcomes #2'
    - Process: Judge a document
      'Step #': '2'
      Action: Apply every declared rule
      Record Produced: The findings
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 business_invariants #2'
    - Process: Judge a document
      'Step #': '3'
      Action: Reach a verdict
      Record Produced: The verdict
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 business_invariants #1'
  belief_verification:
    columns:
    - Belief
    - Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE)
    - Evidence
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Belief: No capability in the current composition decides seed admissibility.
      Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE): NOT_FOUND
      Evidence: No capability produces an admissibility verdict; the only governed call in the domain is transformation::CC_JUDGE_DOCUMENT_V0, authored by this CR.
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #1'
    - Belief: A capability for declaring pure, deterministic transforms already exists.
      Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE): VERIFIED
      Evidence: capability_transforms::CT_PURE_COMPARE_EQUAL_V0, capability_transforms::CT_PURE_EXTRACT_V0
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #2'
    - Belief: A capability for declaring governed calls already exists, and forbids orchestration logic inside them.
      Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE): VERIFIED
      Evidence: transformation::CC_JUDGE_DOCUMENT_V0 composes steps in a pipeline; chaining inside a call is forbidden and enforced at compile time.
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #3'
    - Belief: A workflow form already exists that composes governed calls as a fixed graph without iteration.
      Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE): VERIFIED
      Evidence: transformation::WF_P0_SEED_ADMISSIBILITY_V0, transformation::WF_P1_CHANGE_REQUEST_ADMISSIBILITY_V0
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #4'
    - Belief: An actor form already exists for recording accountability.
      Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE): VERIFIED
      Evidence: transformation::AC_SEED_AUTHOR_V0, transformation::AC_GATE_REVIEWER_V0, transformation::AC_REGISTER_AUTHOR_V0
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #5'
    - Belief: A form for declaring rules as data, separate from the mechanism that enforces them, already exists.
      Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE): NOT_FOUND
      Evidence: No declaration form carries rules applied to a document; the rule set travels as declared workflow input instead.
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #6'
    - Belief: Vocabulary extension is restricted to specific declared categories.
      Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE): VERIFIED
      Evidence: Vocabulary extension contributes only to the categories a reserving declaration marks extensible; no other category admits domain entries.
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #7'
    - Belief: The platform's existing content is largely infrastructure rather than business capability.
      Result (VERIFIED, NOT_FOUND, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE): VERIFIED
      Evidence: The composition is dominated by constitutions, invariants and transport contracts; capability_side_effects::CS_MUTABLE_JSON_V0 and capability_transforms::CT_PURE_EXTRACT_V0 are among the few reusable mechanisms.
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #8'
  pps_baseline_fqdns:
    columns:
    - Capability
    - FQDN
    - What It Does
    - Fit (EXACT, PARTIAL, MISMATCH)
    - Cannot Do
    rows:
    - Capability: Snapshot observation
      FQDN: capability_side_effects::CS_SNAPSHOT_QUERY_V0
      What It Does: Reads an assembled snapshot through the governed inspection surface.
      Fit (EXACT, PARTIAL, MISMATCH): EXACT
      Cannot Do: Nothing — it is read-only by construction.
    - Capability: Mutable JSON store
      FQDN: capability_side_effects::CS_MUTABLE_JSON_V0
      What It Does: Key-addressable JSON state with last-write-wins.
      Fit (EXACT, PARTIAL, MISMATCH): MISMATCH
      Cannot Do: The phases persist nothing; no store is needed.
    - Capability: Judge a document
      FQDN: transformation::CC_JUDGE_DOCUMENT_V0
      What It Does: Parses a document and evaluates a declared rule set against it.
      Fit (EXACT, PARTIAL, MISMATCH): PARTIAL
      Cannot Do: It observes nothing, so it cannot ground a claim about the composition.
    - Capability: Author of record
      FQDN: transformation::AC_REGISTER_AUTHOR_V0
      What It Does: The human accountable for a register's content.
      Fit (EXACT, PARTIAL, MISMATCH): EXACT
      Cannot Do: Nothing.
  gaps:
    columns:
    - Gap
    - Severity
    - Impact
    - Evidence Status
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Gap: No governed call grounds a claim against the composition.
      Severity: CRITICAL
      Impact: A phase that verifies beliefs cannot be built from what exists; judging alone is not grounding.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: S2 belief_verification A capability for declaring governed calls
    - Gap: No declaration form carries rules applied to a document.
      Severity: MEDIUM
      Impact: The rule set travels as declared workflow input, which is sound but is not a reusable form.
      Evidence Status: NOT_FOUND
      Source Finding: 'S1 system_beliefs #6'
  architectural_observations:
    columns:
    - Observation
    - Evidence
    - Evidence Status
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Observation: 'Judging and grounding are separable concerns: one reads a document, the other reads the composition.'
      Evidence: transformation::CC_JUDGE_DOCUMENT_V0 performs the first and binds nothing.
      Evidence Status: VERIFIED
      Source Finding: S2 gaps No governed call grounds a claim
    - Observation: 'Observation is a side effect, not a transform: the same query answers differently against different compositions.'
      Evidence: capability_side_effects::CS_SNAPSHOT_QUERY_V0 is declared read-only with a bound subject.
      Evidence Status: VERIFIED
      Source Finding: S1 constraints A verdict must be reproducible
    - Observation: A rule set held in the artifact that applies it can be compared against its declaration, so the two cannot drift unnoticed.
      Evidence: The seed settles that the sealed copy is generated rather than typed and that the two are compared on every run; nothing in the composition holds a rule set apart from the workflow that applies it.
      Evidence Status: OBSERVED
      Source Finding: 'S1 known_facts #15'
    - Observation: A phase handed the document itself observes nothing at judging time beyond what it was given.
      Evidence: transformation::CC_JUDGE_DOCUMENT_V0 parses a document and evaluates a declared rule set against it, and observes nothing; the seed settles that the document travels with the request.
      Evidence Status: OBSERVED
      Source Finding: 'S1 known_facts #16'
  discovery_concerns:
    columns:
    - Concern
    - Evidence
    - Severity
    - Evidence Status
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Concern: Grounding is only meaningful against the composition the document was written about; against an unrelated snapshot every citation looks like new design.
      Evidence: The identity taxonomy cannot separate proposed-new from fabricated without the CR's declared new artifacts.
      Severity: MEDIUM
      Evidence Status: VERIFIED
      Source Finding: S1 constraints A verdict must be reproducible
  open_questions:
    columns:
    - Question
    - Category
    - Why It Matters
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Question: Should the pipeline's own domain be excluded from reuse search when a business change request runs?
      Category: scope
      Why It Matters: A library change request must not be offered a pipeline mechanism as a reuse candidate.
      Source Finding: S2 gaps No governed call grounds a claim
```

> P2 verifies the semantic model inherited from P1 against the compiled snapshot. It discovers
> facts; it does not decide. Every belief P1 recorded gets a result, and `NOT_FOUND` is a final
> answer — absence is a finding, not a reason to keep searching.

prior_texts.p1:
# Stage 1 — Change Request: Clarification & Fact Capture: transformation / phases

## Machine

```yaml
header:
  Stage: 1 — Change Request (Clarification & Fact Capture)
  CR: new_subdomain
  Status: DRAFT
  Feeds: Stage 2 — Domain Model Discovery
registers:
  cr_type:
    columns:
    - Subdomain
    - Classification (NEW_SUBDOMAIN, EXTEND_SUBDOMAIN, MODIFY, DEPRECATE)
    - Rationale
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Subdomain: design
      Classification (NEW_SUBDOMAIN, EXTEND_SUBDOMAIN, MODIFY, DEPRECATE): NEW_SUBDOMAIN
      Rationale: The pipeline that decides which changes are admissible is a distinct concern from the capabilities it admits, and needs its own governance boundary. It extends nothing that exists.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §1 CR Type #1'
  business_vocabulary:
    columns:
    - Term
    - Definition
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Term: Phase
      Definition: One governed step of the change pipeline, with declared inputs, outputs and rules.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #1'
    - Term: Seed
      Definition: The business problem statement reorganized into fixed registers, and the only input later phases accept.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #2'
    - Term: Seed Phase
      Definition: 'The first phase: it turns a person''s problem statement into a seed.'
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #3'
    - Term: Rule Set
      Definition: The declared set of conditions that decide whether a seed is admissible. Governance, not implementation.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #4'
    - Term: Check Mechanism
      Definition: A means of performing one kind of condition test. Implementation; carries no judgement about what should be tested.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #5'
    - Term: Verdict
      Definition: 'The outcome of applying the rule set to a seed: admissible or inadmissible. There is no partial pass.'
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #6'
    - Term: Finding
      Definition: One recorded failure of one rule, naming the rule, where it failed, and why that matters.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #7'
    - Term: Gate
      Definition: A point where a person accepts responsibility before the pipeline continues.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #8'
    - Term: Author of Record
      Definition: The person accountable for a seed's content.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #9'
    - Term: Business Truth
      Definition: Something the business authoritatively decides or requires.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #10'
    - Term: System Belief
      Definition: Something believed about what already exists, which must be verified rather than assumed.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #11'
    - Term: Clarification
      Definition: An open question that must be asked and never guessed.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §2 Business Vocabulary #12'
  requested_outcomes:
    columns:
    - Outcome
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Outcome: Establish the seed phase as a governed capability of the platform, with its rules readable from the composition rather than from a build tool.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §3 Requested Outcomes #1'
    - Outcome: Produce a verdict for any offered seed, reporting every rule the seed failed rather than stopping at the first failure.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §3 Requested Outcomes #2'
    - Outcome: 'Record accountability: a person is the author of record for a seed, and a person confirms at the gate that it says what they meant.'
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §3 Requested Outcomes #3'
  known_facts:
    columns:
    - Fact
    - Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Fact: The change pipeline must be governed the same way the capabilities it admits are governed.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #1'
    - Fact: The seed phase reorganizes a problem statement; it never decides business content.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #2'
    - Fact: A seed is either admissible or inadmissible; there is no partial pass and no warning tier.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #3'
    - Fact: Every rule is applied to every seed; evaluation does not stop at the first failure.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #4'
    - Fact: The rule set is governance and must be readable from the composition and versioned as declared behaviour.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #5'
    - Fact: A check mechanism is implementation and may live in code, provided it carries no judgement about what should be tested.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #6'
    - Fact: A person is the author of record for a seed, and a person confirms it at the gate.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #7'
    - Fact: The seed phase may not add business content the problem statement does not contain.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #8'
    - Fact: The seed phase may not resolve an open question by guessing.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #9'
    - Fact: The seed phase may not assign any design.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #10'
    - Fact: The seed phase may not promote a System Belief into a Business Truth.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #11'
    - Fact: Changing the rule set requires the same governed change process as any other declared behaviour.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #12'
    - Fact: This change establishes the seed phase and its rule set only.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #13'
    - Fact: The rule set is carried sealed inside the phase's own compiled artifact, alongside the workflow that applies it.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #14'
    - Fact: The sealed rule set is generated from the declaration rather than typed, and the two are compared on every run.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #15'
    - Fact: A phase receives the seed as text, the whole document travelling with the request.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #16'
    - Fact: A verdict must be reproducible from what was judged, so a phase is never handed a location to read.
      Certainty (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW): HIGH
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §4 Known Facts — Business Truths #17'
  system_beliefs:
    columns:
    - Belief
    - Why It Matters
    - Verification Goal
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Belief: No capability in the current composition decides seed admissibility.
      Why It Matters: This CR exists to fill that gap; if such a capability exists, the CR scope changes.
      Verification Goal: Confirm no existing capability produces a seed verdict.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §5 Existing-System Beliefs — Requiring Verification #1'
    - Belief: A capability for declaring pure, deterministic transforms already exists.
      Why It Matters: The check mechanisms are pure transforms and should reuse it rather than author a new form.
      Verification Goal: Identify the governing declaration for pure capability transforms and its purity obligations.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §5 Existing-System Beliefs — Requiring Verification #2'
    - Belief: A capability for declaring governed calls already exists, and forbids orchestration logic inside them.
      Why It Matters: Determines whether a rule can be a governed call or must be data the phase evaluates.
      Verification Goal: Identify the governing declaration for capability contracts and what it forbids.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §5 Existing-System Beliefs — Requiring Verification #3'
    - Belief: A workflow form already exists that composes governed calls as a fixed graph without iteration.
      Why It Matters: Determines how the phase applies many rules to many registers.
      Verification Goal: Identify the workflow declaration and confirm whether iteration is available to it.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §5 Existing-System Beliefs — Requiring Verification #4'
    - Belief: An actor form already exists for recording accountability.
      Why It Matters: The author of record and the gate reviewer are actors.
      Verification Goal: Identify the actor declaration and how a workflow binds one.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §5 Existing-System Beliefs — Requiring Verification #5'
    - Belief: A form for declaring rules as data, separate from the mechanism that enforces them, already exists.
      Why It Matters: If so, the rule set should reuse it rather than invent a carrier.
      Verification Goal: Identify how existing rules are declared apart from their enforcement, and whether that form fits a rule set applied to a document.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §5 Existing-System Beliefs — Requiring Verification #6'
    - Belief: Vocabulary extension is restricted to specific declared categories.
      Why It Matters: Determines whether the controlled vocabularies of the seed may be declared as vocabulary.
      Verification Goal: Identify what may be extended as vocabulary and what may not.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §5 Existing-System Beliefs — Requiring Verification #7'
    - Belief: The platform's existing content is largely infrastructure rather than business capability.
      Why It Matters: Establishes what this subdomain can legitimately reuse.
      Verification Goal: Identify which existing capabilities are reuse candidates for a pipeline subdomain.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §5 Existing-System Beliefs — Requiring Verification #8'
  assumptions:
    columns:
    - Assumption
    - Basis
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Assumption: The seed template's register structure is stable and will not change while this CR is in flight.
      Basis: It is fixed by the reference elicitation already in use.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §6 Assumptions #1'
    - Assumption: A person can supply every register by hand, so the pipeline never depends on an automated drafter.
      Basis: Stated release constraint.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §6 Assumptions #2'
  constraints:
    columns:
    - Constraint
    - Source
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Constraint: What is checked, and why, must be readable from the composition; only how a check runs may live in code.
      Source: Business policy
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §7 Constraints #1'
    - Constraint: The pipeline is reachable only from a local command line, not over any network boundary.
      Source: Business policy
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §7 Constraints #2'
    - Constraint: Dossiers are evidence about a composition and must never become part of one.
      Source: Business policy
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §7 Constraints #3'
    - Constraint: 'A verdict must be reproducible: the same seed and the same rule set always give the same verdict.'
      Source: Business policy
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §7 Constraints #4'
  business_invariants:
    columns:
    - Invariant
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Invariant: A seed has exactly one verdict.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §8 Business Invariants #1'
    - Invariant: Every rule in the rule set is applied to every seed offered to the phase.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §8 Business Invariants #2'
    - Invariant: An inadmissible seed carries at least one finding, and an admissible seed carries none.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §8 Business Invariants #3'
    - Invariant: Every finding names the rule that produced it.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §8 Business Invariants #4'
    - Invariant: Every seed has exactly one author of record.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §8 Business Invariants #5'
    - Invariant: The same seed and rule set always produce the same verdict.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §8 Business Invariants #6'
    - Invariant: A seed that has not passed the gate is never consumed by a later phase.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §8 Business Invariants #7'
  lifecycle_states:
    columns:
    - Object
    - State
    - Meaning
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Object: Seed
      State: Drafted
      Meaning: Reorganized from a problem statement; not yet judged.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §9 Lifecycle States #1'
    - Object: Seed
      State: Admissible
      Meaning: The rule set found no findings.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §9 Lifecycle States #2'
    - Object: Seed
      State: Inadmissible
      Meaning: At least one finding was recorded; the seed cannot proceed.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §9 Lifecycle States #3'
    - Object: Seed
      State: Accepted
      Meaning: A person confirmed at the gate that it says what they meant.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §9 Lifecycle States #4'
    - Object: Rule Set
      State: Active
      Meaning: The declared rules currently deciding admissibility.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §9 Lifecycle States #5'
    - Object: Rule Set
      State: Superseded
      Meaning: Replaced by a later version through a governed change.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §9 Lifecycle States #6'
  business_events:
    columns:
    - Event
    - When It Occurs
    - Significance
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Event: Seed Offered
      When It Occurs: When a seed is submitted to the phase for judgement.
      Significance: The phase has something to decide about.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §10 Business Events #1'
    - Event: Verdict Reached
      When It Occurs: When the rule set has been applied in full.
      Significance: The seed's admissibility is established and recorded.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §10 Business Events #2'
    - Event: Seed Accepted
      When It Occurs: When a person confirms the seed at the gate.
      Significance: Accountability is recorded and later phases may consume it.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §10 Business Events #3'
    - Event: Seed Rejected
      When It Occurs: When a verdict is inadmissible, or a person declines at the gate.
      Significance: The change does not proceed, and the cause is recorded.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §10 Business Events #4'
  authority_boundaries:
    columns:
    - Business Object
    - Authoritative Owner
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Business Object: Problem Statement
      Authoritative Owner: The person who wrote it
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §11 Authority Boundaries #1'
    - Business Object: Seed content
      Authoritative Owner: The author of record
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §11 Authority Boundaries #2'
    - Business Object: Rule Set
      Authoritative Owner: Phases
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §11 Authority Boundaries #3'
    - Business Object: Verdict
      Authoritative Owner: Phases
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §11 Authority Boundaries #4'
    - Business Object: Finding
      Authoritative Owner: Phases
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §11 Authority Boundaries #5'
    - Business Object: Gate acceptance
      Authoritative Owner: The gate reviewer
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §11 Authority Boundaries #6'
  out_of_scope:
    columns:
    - Item
    - Reason
    - Source Finding
    rows:
    - Item: The remaining phases of the pipeline.
      Reason: This change establishes the seed phase only; the rest arrive as later change requests.
      Source Finding: 'CR seed §12 Out of Scope #1'
    - Item: Automated drafting of a seed.
      Reason: The pipeline must not depend on it; it may be added later behind the same rules.
```
